'''Armed conflicts and attacks''' 
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Battle of Donbas (2022)|Battle of Donbas]]
****[[Battle of Sievierodonetsk (2022)|Battle of Sievierodonetsk]]
*****Ukrainian authorities say that [[Russian Ground Forces|Russian forces]] have entered [[Sieverodonetsk]], [[Luhansk Oblast]], leaving the city without water. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/5/29/russia-ukraine-live-moscow-says-donbas-liberation-a-priority (Al Jazeera)]
****[[Donetsk People's Republic|Rebel forces]] say a Ukrainian shelling attack in [[Donetsk]] has killed five civilians (including a teenager) and left 13 injured. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-politics-africa-b63acd1869820e56518198029d461a5b (AP)] [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2022/05/30/war-in-ukraine-russian-forces-storm-eastern-city-of-sievierodonetsk_5985069_4.html (Le Monde)]
****A [[French people|French]] [[journalist]] is killed by Russian [[shell (projectile)|shelling]] in Luhansk Oblast, according to the region's governor [[Serhiy Haidai]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/french-journalist-killed-shelling-ukraines-luhansk-region-governor-2022-05-30/ (Reuters)]
***A [[car bomb]] is detonated in [[Russian occupation of Zaporizhzhia Oblast|Russian-occupied]] [[Melitopol]], [[Zaporizhzhia Oblast]], injuring at least three people. Russian authorities blame pro-Ukrainian residents for the incident. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/bomb-hits-russian-occupied-ukraine-city-melitopol-russian-ukraine-officials-2022-05-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]; [[2021–2022 Democratic Republic of the Congo attacks]]
**Fifteen people are killed in a suspected [[Islamist]] attack by the [[Allied Democratic Forces]] in [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/suspected-islamist-militants-kill-15-east-congo-village-2022-05-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Southeastern Nigeria]]
**[[Nigeria]]n police say that unknown [[militant]]s have [[kidnap]]ped a [[prelate]] in [[Abia State]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nigeria-west-africa-religion-kidnapping-665cf8afc75556c07b4f7d305dbaeb5e (AP)]
*[[Nigerian bandit conflict]]
**[[Bandit]]s kill up to 30 [[vigilante]]s in [[Zamfara State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/bandits-shoot-tens-vigilantes-nigerias-northwestern-zamfara-state-2022-05-31/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Kherson military–civilian administration|Russian occupation of Kherson]], [[2022 food crises]]
**[[Russia]] begins exporting [[grain]] from the occupied [[Kherson Oblast]] in [[Southern Ukraine]] to Russia. Russian-occupying administration official [[Kirill Stremousov]] says that the administration was also "working on the supplies of [[sunflower seed]]s to local and Russian processing plants". Ukraine accuses Russia of stealing its grain. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities/pro-moscow-kherson-region-starts-grain-exports-russia-tass-2022-05-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**After weeks of deliberations, all of the [[European Union]] member states agree to impose an oil embargo on most oil imports from Russia (with the exception of that brought by pipelines), to be fully implemented by the end of the year, and cut off [[Sberbank]] from [[SWIFT]]. [https://www.npr.org/2022/05/30/1102083611/eu-agree-partial-russian-oil-embargo?t=1653996760170 (NPR)]
*A report by the [[Blue Marine Foundation]] found that fishing vessels from the European Union were illegally harvesting fish in the [[exclusive economic zone]]s off the coasts of [[India]], [[Somalia]] and [[Mozambique]] even as the stocks of [[yellowfin tuna]] were on the verge of collapse. [https://www.occrp.org/en/daily/16391-report-eu-vessels-linked-to-illegal-fishing-in-the-indian-ocean (OCCRP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Hurricane Agatha]]
**One person is killed in [[Tapachula, Chiapas]], as Hurricane Agatha approaches [[Mexico]]. [https://www.diariopresente.mx/mexico/agatha-cobra-su-primera-victima-en-chiapas-turista-no-respeto-las-advertencias/334129 (''Diario Presente'')]
*Five people are injured after a school bus crashes into a ditch and rolls over in [[Roztoka, Tarnów County]], [[Poland]]. [https://apnews.com/article/poland-46564d4903b6e4aeae5dc564a8738787 (AP)]
*The wreckage of the [[Cessna 182]] that disappeared from radar the previous day is found near [[Broćanac, Croatia|Broćanac]], [[Croatia]]. All four people on board were killed. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/small-plane-crashes-in-croatia-killing-all-4-on-board/2022/05/30/dfbe9326-e006-11ec-ae64-6b23e5155b62_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*Two people are killed and 20 others are injured after a car crashes into a crowd in [[Lincoln, Nebraska|Lincoln]], [[Nebraska]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nebraska-lincoln-323f0c0dc21a3b4680573ec9693fa529 (AP)]

**[[Thailand]] reports its first case of [[monkeypox]]. [https://www.thaipbsworld.com/thailand-reports-first-case-of-monkeypox-in-transit-passenger-to-australia/ (ThaiPBS)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Status of Jerusalem]], [[Foreign relations of Israel]], [[Foreign relations of Suriname]]
**[[Suriname]]se Foreign Minister [[Albert Ramdin]] says that Suriname will open an [[List of diplomatic missions in Israel|embassy]] in [[Jerusalem]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/suriname-to-open-an-embassy-in-jerusalem-in-the-near-future/ (''Times of Israel'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Politics of Transnistria]]
** [[Aleksandr Rozenberg]] is sworn as new [[Prime Minister of Transnistria]]. [https://novostipmr.com/en/news/22-05-30/president-held-working-meeting-leadership-state-authorities-and (novostipmr.com)]
*[[2022 Australian federal election]]
**[[2022 Liberal Party of Australia leadership election]]
***Former [[Minister for Defence (Australia)|Minister for Defence]] [[Peter Dutton]] is elected unopposed as [[Leader of the Liberal Party of Australia|Leader]] of the [[Liberal Party of Australia]] and, by extension, [[Leader of the Opposition (Australia)|Leader of the Opposition]] following former [[Prime Minister of Australia|Prime Minister]] [[Scott Morrison]]'s resignation. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2022/may/30/peter-dutton-elected-unopposed-as-liberal-party-leader-with-sussan-ley-as-deputy (''The Guardian'')]
**[[2022 National Party of Australia leadership spill]]
***Former [[Deputy Prime Minister of Australia|Deputy Prime Minister]] [[Barnaby Joyce]] is removed as Leader of the [[National Party of Australia]] in a [[leadership spill]] and replaced by his former Deputy and former [[Minister for Agriculture and Northern Australia]] [[David Littleproud]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2022/may/30/david-littleproud-elected-new-nationals-leader-with-perin-davey-as-deputy (''The Guardian'')]
**As vote counting continues, the [[Australian Labor Party]] achieves a majority in the [[Australian House of Representatives|House of Representatives]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2022/may/30/labor-secures-majority-government-despite-record-non-major-party-vote-and-crossbench (''The Guardian'')]
